title: The Starving Light
text: A small, pale, lonely light floats in the dark. As it drifts toward your lamps they gutter and dim, their flames bending toward it. It is hungry, as it always is.

options.label: Feed it a lamp; nothing should be that hungry.

outcomes.text: It drinks the flame and grows bright, then goes ahead of you, lighting the way.

options.label: The cleverest traps it in a jar before it eats every light you have.

outcomes.text: Starlight beats against the glass of the jar.
It eats the jar and keeps eating. It tastes like you.

options.label: Douse every light and let it pass; better dark than devoured.

outcomes.text: The dark is utter until it goes, and it takes its time.
